verdict.rationale: Feitian's docs describe FIDO2-based passwordless sign-in to Azure AD/Office 365 and web services "without typing anything," and mention managing credential-related operations on the key. That implies discoverable credentials, but the docs never explicitly name resident keys or discoverable credentials and only show the Azure AD/Microsoft context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of resident/discoverable credential support, resident-credential storage capacity, usernameless flows across general WebAuthn services, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the key stores discoverable FIDO2 credentials (resident keys / device-bound passkeys) so users can sign in to WebAuthn services without typing a username

citations.quote: the combination of Azure Active Directory (or Office 365 Accounts) and FEITIAN biometric enabled security keys to authentication to PC and Web services without typing anything
manage your FIDO devices(including FIDO PIN and credential related operations)
Fully compatible to W3C's Web Authentication Standard with HID interface.
